issues.description: run() returns bare nil on leader-panic path, relocating the nil-deref into every caller
issues.detail: When CompareAndSwap fails and t.result.Load() returns nil, the new branch returns nil from run(). Callers treat *result as non-nil and will deref output.done/Fatal. The fix moves the nil-deref upstream rather than eliminating it. Either store a failure-value (Fatal set) on panic so run() never returns nil, or make every caller check.

issues.description: TOCTOU race between CompareAndSwap and t.result.Load() is not fully closed
issues.detail: Between CAS failing and the follow-up Load, the leader can panic and clear t.result to nil. The patch handles one snapshot but the two call sites handle the same race inconsistently and the memory-ordering contract is unstated. The root model — using t.result as both identity and presence signal, mutating to nil on panic — keeps the window open by construction.

issues.description: Comment 'Leader panicked but we did see a result' contradicts the code on the nil-return branch
issues.detail: On the path where output is nil, the comment claims a result was seen. It is either a typo for 'did not see a result' or the code is wrong. Comments that contradict the branch they annotate are worse than none, especially in a concurrency primitive.

issues.description: No regression test for the panicking-leader race
issues.detail: A concurrency bug that produces a nil-deref needs a deterministic reproducer: inject a panic in the leader, have N waiters, assert they all get a sensible error. The diff adds zero tests, so the race will silently regress.

issues.description: Shadowed `output` in the CAS-failure branch hurts readability
issues.detail: Inside run(), `output := t.result.Load()` shadows the named return `output`. A reader must track two outputs in one function. Rename the local (e.g. `winner`) so the named return is the only `output`.

issues.description: PR mixes a behavior-changing race fix with the checkCycle refactor extraction
issues.detail: Extracting checkCycle and patching the race are both fine in isolation, but combining them makes the actual fix harder to bisect and review. Split into a pure no-behavior refactor and a minimal race fix.

synthesis.summary: NEEDS-WORK. The panel agrees the race fix is half-done: returning bare nil from run() when the leader panicked simply relocates the nil-deref to every caller of *result. The simpler design is to store a failure-value (Fatal set) on panic so run() never returns nil, closing the TOCTOU window by construction. The checkCycle extraction is a clean refactor, but it should be split from the race fix, the contradictory comment fixed, the shadowed `output` renamed, and a deterministic regression test added for the panicking-leader case.
